Les Dames d'Escoffier New York Archive

The 2016 accretion to the Les Dames d'Escoffier Archive contains documentation relating to the philanthropic, organizational, and social activities of the society. Materials include CDs and floppy disks, membership directories, newsletters and journals, meeting minutes, fundraising event planning materials, and DVD records of the activities of the presidents of the society from 2011-2014.
